label: Diagram D3
caption: Diagram D3 Area
description: Diagram D3, "Area", has three parts. a. "Surface area: roofs and rooflights" ("In each case measure the visible area") shows i. "Flat or monopitch roof", a section with green lines, "Measure from outermost point of roof at eaves or verge" and "If a lean-to roof, measure from the face of wall to the outermost point of roof"; ii. "Double pitch roof", a section of a gabled grey roof with a green line from the "Highest point of roof slope" down the slope to the eaves, plus an elevation of a hipped roof with green lines at "Lowest point of roof slope at eaves", "Outermost point of roof" and "If a hipped roof, measure to outermost point of roof at base area"; iii. "Rooflight", a section with green lines on "Roof sheeting" and "Rooflight". b. "Floor area: Room, garage, conservatory or outbuilding, measure to inner surface of enclosing walls", a plan of a green room with a door gap. c. "Floor area: Storey, part or compartment, measure to inner surface of enclosing walls and include internal walls and partitions", a like plan with an internal partition, noted "When there is not an outer enclosing wall, measure to the outermost edge of the floor slab".
